critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and Product Manager must be dedicated (not shared) across Phases 1–4; Frontend Developer can absorb 2–3 days slack on UI tasks in Phase 2–3.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Existing dashboard audit completed and technical debt documented
SSO provider identity confirmed and sandbox access validated

tasks.name: Audit existing customer analytics dashboard codebase and document technical debt
tasks.definition_of_done: Technical debt inventory document delivered; codebase health assessment (test coverage, deployment pipeline, known constraints) documented.

tasks.name: Confirm SSO provider identity and validate sandbox access with API documentation
tasks.definition_of_done: SSO provider confirmed (Okta/Azure AD/Google/other); sandbox credentials issued; API docs reviewed and grant flows validated.

tasks.name: Validate email service provisioning and confirm delivery SLA
tasks.definition_of_done: Email service confirmed (SMTP/SendGrid/SES/other); delivery SLA documented; if not provisioned, procurement timeline established.

tasks.name: Document PagerDuty integration scope boundary and escalation requirements
tasks.definition_of_done: PagerDuty scope document signed off; threshold-based alerting vs. custom escalation/on-call automation decision documented.

tasks.name: Design real-time reporting and alerting architecture (ER diagram, API contracts, alert flow)
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture document with ER diagram, REST API contracts, alert threshold evaluation logic, and integration points (SSO, email, PagerDuty) approved by team.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: SSO integration and user authentication complete
Sprint 2: Real-time dashboard refresh and custom report builder complete
Sprint 3: Email scheduling and PagerDuty alert integration complete
Core features implemented and internal demo completed

tasks.name: Implement SSO authentication integration with existing dashboard
tasks.definition_of_done: SSO login flow integrated; user session tokens validated; existing user table mapped to SSO identity; sandbox testing passed.

tasks.name: Build real-time dashboard data refresh mechanism (15-minute polling or WebSocket)
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard KPI widgets refresh every 15 minutes; data freshness verified in staging; no performance degradation on existing queries.

tasks.name: Design and implement custom report builder UI (metric selection, date range filters)
tasks.definition_of_done: Report builder UI allows metric selection and date range filtering; generates report in < 5 seconds; UX tested with 3 CSMs.

tasks.name: Implement report generation backend (query builder, aggregation logic)
tasks.definition_of_done: Report queries execute in < 5 seconds for 2-year data range; aggregation logic tested against sample datasets; performance baseline established.

tasks.name: Implement PDF and CSV export functionality
tasks.definition_of_done: Reports export to PDF and CSV; formatting matches design spec; file downloads tested in Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

tasks.name: Build email scheduling backend (cron job, template rendering, delivery queue)
tasks.definition_of_done: Scheduled reports generated and queued for delivery; email templates rendered with report data; delivery queue integrated with email service API.

tasks.name: Design email scheduling UI (schedule frequency, recipient list, template selection)
tasks.definition_of_done: UI allows schedule frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), recipient selection, and template preview; UX tested with 3 CSMs.

tasks.name: Implement alert threshold configuration backend (CRUD operations, validation)
tasks.definition_of_done: Alert thresholds stored in database; CRUD API endpoints tested; threshold validation logic prevents invalid configurations.

tasks.name: Design alert configuration UI (threshold input, metric selection, PagerDuty routing)
tasks.definition_of_done: UI allows threshold configuration and metric selection; PagerDuty routing options displayed; UX tested with 3 CSMs.

tasks.name: Implement PagerDuty integration (threshold evaluation, alert triggering, webhook handling)
tasks.definition_of_done: Threshold breaches trigger PagerDuty alerts; alert payload includes metric name, threshold, and current value; webhook responses logged.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo and gather team feedback on core features
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo covers SSO login, dashboard refresh, custom report creation, email scheduling, and alert configuration; feedback documented and prioritized.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 4: Email delivery reliability and alert edge cases tested
Sprint 5: Regression testing and security review completed
All integrations tested and security review completed

tasks.name: Test email delivery reliability (retry logic, bounce handling, delivery confirmation)
tasks.definition_of_done: Email delivery tested with 100+ test messages; retry logic verified for failed deliveries; bounce handling documented; delivery SLA compliance confirmed.

tasks.name: Test alert threshold edge cases (boundary values, rapid threshold breaches, alert deduplication)
tasks.definition_of_done: Edge cases tested: boundary values, rapid breaches, deduplication; alert payload correctness verified; no duplicate alerts sent.

tasks.name: Run regression test suite against existing dashboard features
tasks.definition_of_done: All existing dashboard features tested; no regressions detected; performance baseline compared to pre-enhancement state.

tasks.name: Conduct security review (SSO token handling, data access controls, SQL injection prevention)
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review checklist completed; SSO token handling validated; data access controls verified; SQL injection and XSS prevention confirmed.

tasks.name: Test end-to-end integration (SSO → dashboard → report → email → PagerDuty)
tasks.definition_of_done: Full user journey tested: login via SSO, create report, schedule delivery, configure alert, receive email and PagerDuty notification; all steps verified.

tasks.name: Test data retention policy enforcement (2-year data purge, audit logging)
tasks.definition_of_done: Data older than 2 years purged automatically; audit log records purge events; compliance with data retention policy verified.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with Customer Success Team

tasks.name: Execute UAT with Customer Success Team (5 CSMs, 2-hour session)
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT session conducted with 5 CSMs; feedback documented; critical issues logged; sign-off obtained for go-live readiness.

tasks.name: Resolve critical and high-priority bugs from UAT and regression testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All critical bugs fixed and verified in staging; high-priority bugs resolved; remaining low-priority bugs documented for post-launch backlog.

tasks.name: Conduct load testing (concurrent users, report generation under load, email queue throughput)
tasks.definition_of_done: Load test simulates 50 concurrent users; report generation latency < 10 seconds under load; email queue processes 1000+ messages/hour; no timeouts.

tasks.name: Write deployment runbook, user documentation, and training materials
tasks.definition_of_done: Deployment runbook covers pre-flight checks, rollback procedure, and post-deployment validation; user guide covers report creation, scheduling, and alerts; training slides prepared.

tasks.name: Prepare production deployment checklist and smoke test plan
tasks.definition_of_done: Deployment checklist includes database migrations, feature flag toggles, and rollback triggers; smoke test plan covers critical user journeys.

tasks.name: Execute production deployment (database migrations, code release, feature flag activation)
tasks.definition_of_done: Code deployed to production; database migrations applied; feature flags activated; deployment log reviewed for errors.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production (login, report creation, email delivery, alert triggering)
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke tests passed: SSO login, custom report creation, email delivery, alert triggering; no critical issues detected in production.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from Product Owner and Customer Success leadership
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off email received from Product Owner and CS leadership; launch announcement prepared; support escalation process documented.
